summary: check rich-text editor JSON against an allowlist; render it as an email
use_when: what users compose in a WYSIWYG box must stick to permitted formatting before it is stored; collect tagged users
not_for: HTML sanitizing or escaping of arbitrary markup: it validates the editor's JSON tree, and its only renderer builds an email letter
enforcing the editor's content model: which node may sit inside which is not checked; only leaf nodes may not carry content
converting a document to Markdown, or rendering it as a web page
